overview.title: The GPT-2 OpenWebText run
overview.summary: Settings that train a 124M GPT on OpenWebText with a large token batch.

sections.title: The GPT-2 OpenWebText run
sections.pseudocode:
Turn the run log on, under the name gpt2-124M.
Use batch 12 and context 1024.
Accumulate 5 times 8 micro-batches.
Train and decay the learning rate for 600000 steps.
Score every 1000 steps, using 200 batches.
Log every 10 steps.
Decay weights by 1e-1.
# Context: The comment above the batch math says 12 times 1024 times 5 times 8 GPUs is about half a million tokens per step.
# Insight: This file does not shrink the model. It keeps train.py's 12-layer, width-768 GPT and changes the schedule and the batch.
